sources_accessed.access_method: Zenodo REST API & staged regional bounding-box filtering [68E, 8N, 98E, 37N]
sources_accessed.actual_file_size: Global SHP_perimeters: 3,049,703,575 bytes; Indian staged subset: 11,858 bytes

sources_accessed.license: Government of India Open Data / MoEFCC Official Bulletins

sources_accessed.license: NASA Open Data Policy / LP DAAC Public Access
sources_accessed.access_method: NASA CMR STAC search and staged Indian sinusoidal tile parsing (h23v05, h24v05, h25v06)
sources_accessed.geographic_coverage: Global (Granules h23v05, h24v05, h25v06 for India)

sources_accessed.authority: Forest Survey of India (FSI) India State of Forest Report
sources_accessed.license: Government of India National Forest Inventory Open Data
sources_accessed.access_method: Forest Canopy Density statutory classification (VDF > 70%, MDF 40-70%, OF 10-40%, Scrub < 10%)

sources_accessed.authority: Copernicus Global Land Service / VITO Remote Sensing
sources_accessed.access_method: 100m Discrete Land Cover Classification (Class 40 = Cropland, Class 20/30 = Shrub/Grassland)

forest_gate_specification.rule_description: A candidate detection is labeled Class 2 (FOREST_FIRE) if and only if it intersects a valid wildland fire perimeter/cluster AND satisfies FSI Canopy Density >= 10% OR falls within a statutory Reserved Forest / Protected Area. Cropland intersections are diverted to AGRICULTURAL_FIRE_CANDIDATE; open scrub without forest status is classified as AMBIGUOUS.

gate_outcomes.FOREST_FIRE: Canopy cover >= 10.0% OR statutory Reserved Forest / Protected Area
gate_outcomes.AGRICULTURAL_FIRE_CANDIDATE: Located on cultivated cropland parcel (Copernicus Class 40)
gate_outcomes.AMBIGUOUS: Canopy cover < 10.0% in open scrub/grassland without reserved forest status
gate_outcomes.EXCLUDED: Non-vegetated barren, water, urban, or out-of-bounds terrain

independence_invariant.rule: Multiple FIRMS detections belonging to the same physical wildfire event are NOT independent training examples. All downstream partitioning must group strictly by fire_event_id to guarantee zero spatiotemporal split leakage.
